    # Select only the target columns

    # Also, raised_amount_usd may be float, convert to int after filling NaNs with 0
    # company_permalink is string, ensure no NaNs (drop rows if company_permalink missing)

    # Select columns, if any missing, fill with default values

                df[col] = 0
            elif col == 'raised_amount_usd':
                df[col] = 0
    
    df_sel = df[target_columns].copy()
